titleEn: You Can Cry—I'll Link Trunks with You!

pages.text: Rain swelled the river, keeping the three children inside all day. Round-bellied youngest Sonu fell while running and cried. Mina bumped a toe but kept their mouth shut.
Mom held Sonu on her lap and patted their back. "Does it hurt you, too?" "No. Middle children don't cry." Mina envied Mom's lap.
The toe throbbed, and their throat tightened. Mina bit their lip and sat beside the lamp. Hic, hic—hiccups began.
Mom sat beside Mina. "You have hiccups." "Hic—no, hic—" Mina could not finish speaking.
Mom gently touched the toe. "That must have hurt. You can cry if you want." Mina looked up.
Mom stretched her trunk and curled it around Mina's. "You Can Cry—I'll Link Trunks with You!" The words brought bursting tears. "Waaah!"
After a long cry, the hiccups stopped. The tight throat felt clear. "Oh... I'm okay now." Mina sniffled and lifted their face.
Sonu toddled over and gently pressed a towel to Mina's eyes. "All wiped!" Mina gave a little smile.
Sniffling, Mina called Mom. "Please hold me a little longer." Rain pattered outside.
Mom wrapped both children side by side in her arms. Mina leaned against her. "It's good beside you."
